subject: english
title: Reading Comprehension
description: Lower Key Stage 2 word meaning and comprehension: synonyms and antonyms, common idioms and figurative language, and dictionary skills for checking word meanings.

objectives.statement: Use knowledge of synonyms and antonyms to understand and choose words that capture the writer's meaning.
Recognise some common idioms and figurative language and understand that their meaning is not literal.
Use dictionaries to check the meaning of words they have read.
